protocol.acceptance: Every scoped semantic and operational check; explicit-facts parity; source stability; zero network/provider/model-load attempts
protocol.aggregation: Separate validation/test, cardinality and per customer; overlapping query criteria, no independent-row confidence intervals

arms.explicit_current_facts: Same engine/ranker, independently authored prefix facts supplied afresh
arms.owner_blind_memory: Same engine/ranker, latest written property snapshot per customer; property key discarded
arms.scoped_memory: HTTP GET of requested customer/property, real engine/ranker

protocol.assignment: IDs first; sort SHA256('225-ownership-v1:'+customer_id); first 9 train, next 3 validation, last 3 test
protocol.execution: validation then test; same fixed protocol, no tuning between partitions
protocol.expansion: Within each assigned split, cycle 1,2,4 properties, then author chronological steps
protocol.knowledge: Only successfully recorded prefix available at each actual HTTP query; completion occurrence is not knowledge time
protocol.limits: SQLite standalone production router with production HomeInput; not browser, PostgreSQL, migration, provider accuracy, population benefit or physical savings
protocol.negative_control: Owner-blind single-property history must tie; multi-property mismatches demonstrate lost binding, not superior algorithm
protocol.population: 15 authored fictional customers; no NEED/customer linkage
protocol.reference: Authored raw state and semantic constraints, not engine outputs
protocol.train_use: design-only; not executed, no fit, no trained metrics or model selection
